literal.prompt: Какой испанский парк служит ключевой остановкой птиц между Европой и Африкой?

literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO identifies Doñana at Spain’s southwest tip and describes it as an international bird refuge on the East-Atlantic flyway, a bottleneck between Western Europe and West Africa. Other labels are an English park, five Ligurian villages in Italy, and the Poland/Belarus forest; they do not match the Spanish bird-route fact.
literalGroups.locator: UNESCO685 L46, L49, L58; UNESCO422 L30; UNESCO826 L47–L48; UNESCO33 L29.

literalGroups.literal: Это Доньяна. Здесь чередуются болота, дюны и средиземноморские леса.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO’s full site description lists marshes, lagoons, peat bogs, fixed/mobile dunes, forests and shrubs; this supports the existing explanation about marshes, dunes, and Mediterranean woodland without requiring a rewrite.
literalGroups.locator: UNESCO685 Russian description L25; English synthesis L46–L47.

literalGroups.literal: Лейк-Дистрикт — английский национальный парк с ледниковыми озёрами и высочайшей горой Англии.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Official Lake District geology states singular “England’s highest mountain” and describes glacial shaping of lakes/landforms. Correct only the unsupported plural superlative; retain the supported glacial-lakes statement.
literalGroups.locator: Lake geology L42–L44; official facts L40–L63.

literalGroups.literal: Чинкве-Терре — итальянский парк и культурный ландшафт пяти прибрежных деревень на террасированных склонах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO names Cinque Terre as the collective name for five villages on the Ligurian coast and describes stone-walled vine terraces; note is true for this distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Доньяна — испанский парк водно-болотных угодий у устья Гвадалквивира, важный для перелётных птиц.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO places Doñana at the Guadalquivir estuary where it empties into the Atlantic and describes migratory/wintering birds. Narrow “delta” to “estuary”; preserve the remaining correct note.

literalGroups.literal: Беловежская пуща — древний лес на границе Польши и Беларуси, где живёт крупнейшая свободная популяция зубров.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO confirms Białowieża Forest at the Poland/Belarus border, old-growth forest, and the largest free-roaming European bison population; Russian “зубр” is correct.
